metadata.title: FBI Investigating ‘Suspicious’ Cyber Activities on Critical Surveillance Network

left: The FBI detected suspicious cyber activities on an internal network used to manage wiretaps and intelligence surveillance warrants and is investigating the incident's seriousness.
The affected network is unclassified but contains sensitive law enforcement information, including surveillance returns and personally identifiable information related to FBI investigations.
Sophisticated techniques exploiting a commercial internet service provider's infrastructure were used to bypass network security controls during the cyber incident.
Officials note challenges in FBI cybersecurity capabilities amid leadership changes, complicating efforts to prevent foreign cyberattacks.
center: The FBI identified and addressed "suspicious activities" on its networks related to wiretaps and intelligence surveillance.
The FBI did not provide details on the nature of the activities or when they were identified.
U.S. government networks are routinely targeted by hackers, with recent incidents at the Congressional Budget Office and federal courts.
right: The FBI is investigating suspicious activities on an internal system containing sensitive surveillance and investigation information, discovered on February 17, 2026.

The affected system is unclassified but holds law enforcement sensitive data, including pen register and trap and trace surveillance returns and personally identifiable information about FBI investigation subjects.
